bootstrap.estimator: retain every frame in each sampled scene; equal-frame target, not equal-scene mean
bootstrap.corrected_ci: conditional on N<P, nonnegative noise, finite positive powers, and |corrected rho|<=1+1e-10; coverage reported for every band
bootstrap.label_probability: resampling frequency, not a Bayesian probability or population class probability

spectral_reanalysis.correction_policy: N>=P, negative noise, nonfinite/nonpositive powers, or |corrected rho|>1+1e-10 invalidate the primary correction. Only numerical overruns within 1e-10 are clipped. Raw moment estimate is retained separately.
spectral_reanalysis.uncertainty_limits: Conditions on first within-scene/exposure noise pair and fitted gains; scene bootstrap does not separately model finite noise-pair selection uncertainty.

protocol.data_source: 50 unique real reference images from released Sony test image rows; one per scene, no short-frame weighting; original build_pairs agrees exactly with all 598 recorded scene/LQ rows
protocol.preprocessing: original resize 960x512, float32/255, reverse channels, nearest-even uint8 GT; exact equality to original loader checked
protocol.float_exact_control: known mathematical perturbation without post-perturbation clipping or rounding; attenuation may ring outside [0,1]
protocol.canonical_quantized_control: same perturbation clipped and nearest-even uint8 before diagnostic, matching decomposition input convention
protocol.spectral_note: correlation is per image and averaged; both raw and positive-global-gain-matched power retained; no windowing; DC included
protocol.smooth_spatial_gain: 1-k*(1+0.8*sin(2*pi*y/H)*sin(2*pi*x/W)); k analytically matches per-scene global-gain MSE
protocol.frequency_attenuation: factor 0.25 on fixed radial bands index >=6 (f>0.30), 1 elsewhere; no threshold fitting
protocol.threshold_policy: 0.20 is carried from original diagnostic solely for boundary count, never selected using these controls
